item.title: Devanagari Sounds and Script Basics
item.description: Speak practical everyday Hindi from day one: Devanagari sounds, core grammar, and real conversations. Lesson 1: Devanagari Sounds and Script Basics This lesson teaches you to pronounce Hindi clearly from the start, and introduces the Devanagari script so you can recognize the letters you will see…

item.title: Greetings, Introductions, and Survival Phrases
item.description: Lesson 2: Greetings, Introductions, and Survival Phrases This lesson gives you your first real social toolkit: greeting people politely, introducing yourself, and surviving conversations when you do not understand something. These phrases are the highest-value sentences in the language because they…

item.title: Hona, Gender, and the Present Tense
item.description: Lesson 3: Hona, Gender, and the Present Tense This lesson tackles the most important verb in Hindi — hona (to be) — plus the present tense and the gender system, which lets you describe what you do every day. Hona appears in nearly every sentence, and the present tense is built from a verb stem…

item.title: Numbers, Time, Days — The Everyday Vocabulary Core
item.description: Lesson 4: Numbers, Time, Days — The Everyday Vocabulary Core This lesson builds your everyday number vocabulary: counting, telling time, and using days, months, and dates. Numbers are pure utility — prices, phone numbers, addresses, schedules — and telling the time unlocks appointments, opening…

item.title: Asking Questions — Directions, Shopping, and Small-Talk Dialogues
item.description: Lesson 5: Asking Questions — Directions, Shopping, and Small-Talk Dialogues This lesson turns you into someone who can get answers: how to form every kind of question, ask for directions, handle a full shopping conversation, and keep small talk going. Up to now you have mostly made statements…

item.title: Talking About the Past — The Past Tense
item.description: Lesson 6: Talking About the Past — The Past Tense This lesson gives you the past tense so you can say what you did, where you went, and what happened. Without a past tense you are stuck in the eternal present; with it, you can tell stories, explain your day, and answer the most common small-talk…

item.title: Making Plans — Future Expressions + Restaurant and Travel Dialogues
item.description: Lesson 7: Making Plans — Future Expressions + Restaurant and Travel Dialogues This lesson teaches you to talk about the future — making plans, accepting invitations, and handling two of the most useful real-world conversations: ordering in a restaurant and navigating travel. Future talk is what…

item.description: Lesson 8: Conversation Practice Drills + Your 30-Day Practice Plan This final lesson does two things: it gives you structured conversation drills that combine everything from Lessons 1–7, and it hands you a concrete 30-day plan so your Hindi keeps growing after the course ends.
